title: REBUILDING MANDATE LIMITED-TIME EVENT OPEN
lines: 01 REBUILDING MANDATE LIMITED-TIME EVENT OPEN
DURATION: March 6, 2026, 08:00 - March 27, 2026, 03:59 (UTC-7)
UNLOCK REQUIREMENT: Clear Main Storyline 1-10

DETAILS: Rebuilding Mandate will be open for a limited time. During the event, players can complete event stages and Urgent Targets to obtain resources. Urgent Targets also grant Resource Points to level up [Promotion Plan] for more event rewards.
[Promotion Plan]
DURATION: March 6, 2026, 08:00 - March 30, 2026, 03:59 (UTC-7)
REWARDS: Shining Steps Collection - Cool Colored Rock 'n' Roll for Puzzle, Furniture 'Emergency Record' Vivarium, Module Materials, Elite Materials, LMD, Battle Records, etc.
Please refer to the official introduction for more details.
02 LIMITED-TIME HEADHUNTING OPEN — ORIENTEERING HEADHUNTING
DURATION: March 6, 2026, 08:00 - March 20, 2026, 03:59 (UTC-7)

DETAILS: During the Orienteering Headhunting, you can select and lock in three 6-star and three 5-star Operators of this pool and raise their rates. The three selected 6-star Operators will be the only 6-star Operators in this headhunting.
All possible Operators
★★★★★★(2%): Mon3tr / Logos / Hoederer / Ascalon / Ray / Thorns the Lodestar
★★★★★(8%): Figurino / Tippi / Rockrock / Fang the Fire-Sharpened / Almond / Proviso
NOTE:

◆ This is a Standard Headhunting. Once the rate-up Operators are selected, only the three selected 6-star Operators will appear in this pool, making up 100% of the 6-star Operators' pull rate. All 5-star Operators from the Standard Headhunting pool may appear, while the three selected 5-star Operators have a boosted rate, comprising 60% of the 5-star Operators' pull rate.

DETAILS: During the event, the following packs will be available from the Store for a limited time.

05 NEWBORN PIVOT LOGIN EVENT OPEN
DURATION: March 6, 2026, 08:00 - March 16, 2026, 03:59 (UTC-7)

DETAILS: During the event, players can log in for 7 days to receive Professional Operator Skill Training Pack (You can select a 4★ Operator that meets the requirements and level a skill to Specialization Level 3), Event Exclusive Furniture, Orundum, etc.
Day 1: Emergency Sanity Concentrate * 1, Professional Operator Skill Training Pack * 1
Day 2: Chip Catalyst * 1, Recruitment Permit * 5
Day 3: Orundum * 200, Skill Summary - 1 * 30
Day 4: Skill Summary - 2 * 20, Expedited Plan * 5
Day 5: Furniture Part * 300, Tactical Battle Record * 20
Day 6: Module Data Block * 1, Pure Gold * 20
Day 7: Skill Summary - 3 * 8, 'Exclusive Theater' Studio Desk Furniture * 1
NOTE:
Please refer to the in-game info for the expiration time of the Emergency Sanity Concentrate from this event.
06 AUTUMN MOON ON GOLDEN OSMANTHUS LOGIN EVENT OPEN

DETAILS: During the event, players can participate in three steps over the first three days: Crust Dough Kneading, Filling Mixing, and Mooncake Making. Completing these steps will reward with different mooncakes (each granting 120 Sanity) and exclusive furniture. Logging in for a total of 5 days during the event will also earn previous event furniture, Orundum, Battle Records, among others.
Day 1 (Crust Dough Kneading): LMD* 30000, Furniture 'Lucent Watchings' Pack * 1
Day 2 (Filling Mixing): Recruitment Permit* 5, Furniture 'Radiant Courtyard' Gift Box * 1
Day 3 (Mooncake Making): Mooncake (grants 120 Sanity)* 1, Exclusive Furniture* 1
Day 4: Tactical Battle Record* 20, Pure Gold* 20
Day 5: Orundum* 200, Expedited Plan* 5
NOTE:
- Please refer to the in-game info for the expiration time of Mooncake from this event.
- You can only obtain the mooncakes and furniture you've pre-selected. Unselected styles will not be available.
Please stay tuned for more information!
